raw.query: SELECT run_id, lead_s, policy, window_name, gpu_hours, p99_ttft_ms FROM current_llm_summary WHERE run_id IN ('riders:ladder_t400_40','riders:ladder_t300_30','riders:ladder_t250_25','riders:ladder_t200_20') ORDER BY gpu_hours
raw.claimed: GPU-h 18.6->20.4 monotonically; TTFT p99 pinned ~1,616 ms
raw.evidence: All 4 ladder runs current (not superseded), same window/population (64804 reqs), lead_s=60; both GPU-h monotonic increase and p99~1616 confirmed. Only nit: expected backing 'v_cost_ratio' is misattributed (has no riders rows, no TTFT col) - real backing is current_llm_summary.
raw.fix: Re-point provenance citation from v_cost_ratio to current_llm_summary; claim itself holds (p99 technically drops ~4ms, well within 'pinned ~1616').
